question: The risk coverage on accidental death in the Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY) is ______ (As of July 2022).
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹2 lakh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana is a government scheme launched on 9th May 2015 by PM Narendra Modi. 
 
• It intends to provide an affordable insurance scheme for the poor and underprivileged people in the age group of 18 to 70 years with a bank account at a premium of Rs.12 per annum; risk coverage of Rs.2 lakh for accidental death and full disability and Rs.1 lakh for partial disability.
 
• 
 Provisions of Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY):

 
 
• PMSBY is a General Insurance Scheme that was revealed by the Finance Minister in the budget speech of 2015-16 to promote insurance penetration in India.
 
• It is an insurance cover provided at a minimal annual premium for the death or disability of the person due to accidents.
 
• The risk coverage of the scheme for accidental death or full disability caused by the accident is Rs. 2 lakhs and for partial disability is Rs. 1 lakh.
 
• People who fall in the age bracket of 18-70 years can avail the benefit of this scheme and get enrolled and they should have a bank account linked with their Aadhaar card.
 
• The annual premium is an amount of Rs. 12.
 
• The pension will be offered by all the public-sector insurance companies like New India Assurance Company, National Insurance Company, United India Insurance Company, The Oriental Insurance Company, etc.
